publication.inGameTestScope: Alpha36: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic dynamic Equipment/Spells card (0-12 spells), bar fill at 6 values x 4 scales, Effects margins; art cut points measured offline; NOT yet observed natively; alpha.35 flat fill did not fix the bar in the real client. Previous scope - Alpha35: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic chat controls, overlap row, Damage header and amounts, foot label vs baked icon, flat bar fill; NOT yet observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha34: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic Aethus-art group card geometry, Damage header/amounts FR-EN, chat fill inset; art composition checked offline from the real texture; NOT yet observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha33: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic card geometry (skin size, content box, 3 details x 3 scales) and provenance tooltip; NOT yet observed natively; alpha.32 passed its tests and still overflowed natively. Previous scope - Alpha32: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic group card component, options, history parser, probe; NOT yet observed natively; event delivery to be measured with groupprobe. Previous scope - Alpha31: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic compact teammate card (bars, values, states, sizes); NOT yet observed natively - alpha.30 passed the same kind of tests and failed natively. Previous scope - Alpha30: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic themed teammate cards (states, native replacement and restore, strata, individual moves, priority over main cards), both zones; NOT yet observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha29: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic teammate cards in the placement engine (0-4 members, collisions, drag, persistence, Bonuses expansion), both zones; NOT yet observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha28: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic launcher proxy click/tooltip, party dead status, leave and empty state; NOT yet observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha27: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic render order (gear above the art rim, native levels restored), both zones; NOT yet observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha26: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic ring geometry (border-centred, keep-outs, default on), both zones; NOT yet observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha25: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic regression reproducing the native mouse stack (owner 3, map 2, gear 2) and the corrected order, both zones; gear click/drag NOT yet observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha24: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic regression for diagnostic command routing (none opens the settings window, each prints, errors printed) and unchanged ordinary commands; commands in the real client NOT yet run. Previous scope - Alpha23: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic regression for the four real screen edges with a short UIParent measurement (all five cards, both zones, drop snap, persistence) and read-only gear diagnostics; real edges and the AzerothHub gear NOT observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha22: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic regression for protected parts measured where they really are, cards dropped on former places, clamp off, map/card probes; real mouse, AzerothHub gear and the clamp behaviour NOT observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha21: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic regression for real screen bounds (letterboxed canvas), edge-flush manual placement and drop snapping, protected-obstacle limit for Bonuses, no-cascade search, map mouse coverage; real mouse, AzerothHub and rendering NOT observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha20: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic regression bench on RENDERED rectangles with every card saved (captured case), map group owner, zoom buttons, seven permanent sockets; real mouse, AzerothHub and rendering NOT observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha19: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic regression for the vertical placement engine (determinism, drag freeze, pinned neighbours, option), seven spells, six damage categories, tooltip and map follower; real mouse, AzerothHub and rendering NOT observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha18: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic regression for Spells indicator, in-place Bonuses (4/12/29 rows, screen edge, Effects, saved positions), Damage hover tooltips (full and partial data) and gear placement; real mouse interaction and AzerothHub NOT observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha17: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic regression for 30-alternation click stability (Hide counted, mock fires no OnHide), six damage rows and stretched art, lair margins, repeated theme/map-button transitions; real mouse interaction and AzerothHub NOT observed natively. Previous scope - Alpha16: Lua 5.0.3/5.1 synthetic regression for drag across refreshes (mock does not fire OnHide: Hide calls counted), socket-centred icons, Damage foot clearance and third-party map buttons; drag and map NOT observed natively.
